clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the calendar year.
Delivery FCA; standard lead time 70 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2025-07-01 to 2027-06-30; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice.

documents.subject: Payment of invoices
documents.author: Tarsevi Döküm Sanayi A.Ş.
documents.text: Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.

documents.subject: Liquidity
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: Call with the managing director of Tarsevi Döküm Sanayi A.Ş.: he asked twice whether we could pay earlier and said the bank is watching every month. 'I cannot sign anything that lowers our margin now.'

documents.subject: Supplier visit
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: Visit at Tarsevi Döküm Sanayi A.Ş.: half the shop floor was idle, two shifts are on short hours, and the MD spoke mostly about cash and the banks.

documents.subject: Capacity
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: Call with sales at Tarsevi Döküm Sanayi A.Ş.: they could take additional parts at short notice; the second shift has been on hold since spring.

documents.author: Tarsevi Döküm Sanayi A.Ş.
documents.text: Our plant is closed from 23 December to 6 January. Please place call-offs for January by 10 December.

persona.summary: Turkish family foundry (380 staff, EUR 15.8 M) in distress: restructuring, bank watching monthly, half the shop floor idle, second shift on hold. We are 3.2 % of its turnover. Pump housing HB 40 is 60/40 with active co-source 70190, so we can shift volume. Red scorecard four quarters running (OTD 52 %, 2652 ppm). Owner offered open-book costing. Trade volume and faster payment for price; past renewals settled 2.6-3.8 pts below its ask.
persona.notes: Needs cash and work for idle shifts; repeatedly asks 10-day payment. Fears margin loss ('cannot sign anything that lowers our margin') and losing HB 40 share to 70190. Price is 19 % under a German-cost should-cost, not its own plant, so no proof it is below its cost. Invited to the HX 80-200 RFQ (per 70120 file).

levers: binding volume to fill second shift
arguments: quality record: red four quarters, OTD 52 %, 2652 ppm
its own cost shares from the offered open book
volume shift to active co-source 70190 (it is dearer at 43.39, no rival-price argument)
binding volume / forecast fills idle capacity
avoid: a bare margin cut with nothing in return
changing terms after its final offer
tactics: Accept its open-book offer: ask for hourly rates and material shares, then argue from them.
Lead with the red scorecard; OTD 52 % is far below the 95 % target.
Offer extra HB 40 quota from 70190 as a binding volume for a visible price step.
Offer 10-14 day payment only against price; cash is its main need.
Frame the deal as cash plus volume, not as a margin cut.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; past renewals settled 2.6-3.8 pts below its ask (2024: asked +3.0 %, settled 0 %).
